owner_intent: The second form is an aggressive calibration trial for precise horizontal/vertical repair placement and a future tabbed metal escutcheon. The metal main/diverter plates must not touch. Educated guesses and a binding/remake outcome are accepted; existing working form remains fallback.
correction_to_prior_recommendation: RF05 reduced-play calculations concern repeatability, not verified centering to the actual trim or separation from the diverter. A snug successful print alone cannot establish a perfected metal-tab specification.
active_requirements: Reference the repair and backing positions to the actual Kohler trim/control assembly. Keep each backing concentric with its factory cover.
Evaluate the two intended metal outer outlines together before filling. The repaired opening must not force an outer plate off its intended center.
Validate or deliberately translate locator coordinates to the final metal tab plane and actual support/bedding depth. Do not copy the form's front-tab XY blindly.
Retain independent form support, unforced insertion/removal, original clearances and the working fallback.
Accept a failed precision trial; do not describe the requested 25-30% risk as a calculated probability.

nominal_evidence.scope: Inferred earlier positions, not physical measurements or uncertainty bounds.

recommendation: Keep RF05 available as a precision experiment using the best current working placement. Treat its outcome as calibration evidence. Establish correct trim alignment and a nonzero, suitably reserved neighboring-plate gap before repair; afterward derive a separately checked tabbed-metal successor at the correct depth. A binding-only check is insufficient.
next_physical_comparison: Use the existing full-size cover/plate overlays and real Kohler parts to assess placement and gap without another caliper survey. No new dimensions requested this turn.
future_tabbed_metal: Owner intends a tabbed successor if the trial validates the relevant fit and placement. Existing FT02 plain-opening plate files remain unchanged and must not be mislabeled as tabbed.
